thread:
mike-support: :rotating_light: getting multiple customer escalations — hosted inference API returning 502/504 and long timeouts since ~15:20 UTC. spike in errors across regions, several customers reporting failed requests and downstream billing retries. Can oncall triage?

alicia-eng-runtime: looking through gateway traces now — lots of "kv read fanout" waits. memcached/edge-kv reads are timing out, gateway falls back to 504 after ~12s. seeing many TCP timeouts and ERR from memcached clients.

ben-platform: curious if this is a hot-prefix issue or general cluster instability. quick metrics: prefix-read qps up ~3x for a small set of prefixes, overall memcached p99 latencies at 1.2s -> some nodes at >3s.

mike-support: customers mention increased token billing errors because webhook ack paths retry and ultimately fail. Priority: reduce customer-facing 5xx first, then investigate root cause.

julia-oncall: plan: patch gateway to lower memcached fanout concurrency and reduce per-request wait to 200ms so we can fallback to origin (cold path) earlier. rolling canary in us-west-2 in 5m if no objections.

alicia-eng-runtime: +1 to gateway fallback. also recommend enabling kv_fanout_single_thread flag (avoid parallel hammering) and temporarily route traffic away from the three memcached nodes reporting high conn counts.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-2245 created and assigned to eng-runtime + platform. Current status: investigating.

ops-bot: memcached cluster status: 3/6 nodes conn-saturated, kernel drops observed, network retransmits rising. looks like TCP queue backlog on those hosts. Suggest cordon + restart to clear kernel TCP state.

ben-platform: repro (from a customer trace):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-13b","input":"hello"}' \
  --max-time 18
# -> 504 gateway after 12s
# gateway log snippet: kv_fanout: timeout waiting for 4/6 responses; returning upstream 504
```

mike-support: thanks — that matches customer repro. Julia, go ahead with gateway patch. I'll notify impacted customers and offer retries/backoff guidance.

julia-oncall: starting canary now (us-west-2). patch will: reduce fanout concurrency, set cache read timeout 200ms, enable fallback to origin path. monitoring dashboards pinned.

alicia-eng-runtime: while canary runs we'll prepare a short-term memcached remediation: cordon the 3 saturated nodes, spin up 3 warm spares and let SRE rejoin. also check if a recent config change bumped client timeouts/parallelism.

ops-bot: cordon scheduled in 10m. rolling restart estimated 8m per node.

ben-platform: I'll update the status page with a note about elevated 5xx due to cache dependency and link this thread.

mike-support: Perfect. Owners: julia -> gateway patch/canary, alicia -> cache remediation and config audit, ben -> customer comms/status page, ops -> node restarts. Update thread when canary shows green or if rollback needed. :thumbsup:
